items.title_zh: 友谊或杠杆:习近平为何在朝鲜?.
items.summary: The Chinese President Xi Jinping has vowed to strengthen his relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un in a rare state visit to Pyongyang.
items.summary_zh: 中国国家主席习近平在平壤罕见国事访问中誓言加强与朝鲜金正恩的关系.

items.title: Iran's strike on Israel suggests the regime's sense of resilience is growing
items.title_zh: 伊朗对以色列的打击表明,该政权的抗御感正在增强。
items.summary: When Iran launched missiles and drones at Israel overnight in response to Israeli attacks on Hezbollah in Lebanon, the immediate military significance of the attack appeared to be limited. The political significance, however, may be far greater.
items.summary_zh: 当伊朗因以色列在黎巴嫩袭击真主党而一夜之间向以色列发射导弹和无人机时,这次袭击的直接军事意义似乎有限. 然而,政治意义可能要大得多。

items.title: Schoolchildren run from collapsing roof as ground shakes in Philippines quake
items.title_zh: 当菲律宾发生地震时,学生们从屋顶倒塌而来
items.summary: Pupils could be heard screaming at a school in Digos as a magnitude-7.8 earthquake struck off the coast of Mindanao island in the southern Philippines.
items.summary_zh: 在菲律宾南部棉兰老岛近海发生的7.8级地震中,学生在迪戈斯的一所学校听到尖叫声。
